name: HW-GPT-Bench
description: HW-GPT-Bench is a hardware-aware benchmark designed to evaluate language model architectures in terms of hardware metrics such as latency, energy consumption, GPU memory usage, and performance. It uses surrogate predictions to approximate these metrics across multiple devices for GPT-2 family architectures, enabling efficient multi-objective optimization simulations.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark with limited community adoption, mainly used in the HW-aware model optimization literature.
notes: Uses surrogate models with calibrated predictions and uncertainty estimates to model hardware metrics; focuses on GPT-2 architectures up to 1.55B parameters.
